title: Termos Biru
genre: Malay piano soul-pop ballad (Ara Johari lane)
subject: a woman returning a blue thermos flask to her old university housemate six years later, her housemate's name still on masking tape on the lid, and the two of them filling it with teh tarik for the drive home
caption: Malay piano soul-pop ballad in the current chart style. Upright piano carrying gospel-tinged chords, soft Hammond organ swells, round electric bass, brushed live drums entering at the first chorus, light gospel-style backing harmonies. Intimate warm studio sound with close-miked piano. Female alto, soulful and controlled, small runs only at phrase ends. 76 BPM, Ab major. Wistful, warm and unhurried. No autotune, no trap drums, no EDM, no rock guitar, no dangdut.
lyrics:
[Intro - upright piano and organ]

[Verse 1]
Termos biru dalam almari
Nama awak masih kat penutup
Pita kertas dah kekuningan
Enam tahun saya pinjam

[Pre-Chorus]
Saya pandu ke Seremban
Hantar balik barang awak

[Chorus]
Termos biru, saya pulangkan
Tutupnya masih ketat
Kita dulu kongsi semua
Sampai lupa siapa punya

[Verse 2]
Awak buka pintu, terjerit
Pegang termos macam bayi
Awak kata, tinggal sekejap
Kita isi teh tarik dulu

[Chorus]
Termos biru, awak isikan
Teh panas untuk jalan
Awak kata, simpan lagi
Pulangkan enam tahun lagi

[Outro - piano, organ hum, soft fade]
